blazers.pulse: Tuesday's 106-105 loss in Minnesota was a gut punch: Portland led by seven with under two minutes left, then went scoreless the last 50 seconds and gave up a McDaniels layup with 2.6 seconds to go. Fans are calling it one of the worst collapses of the year, and it was the second loss in two nights to the Wolves.
storylines: Lost 106-105 at Minnesota after a late inbounds steal; Jaden McDaniels hit the winner
Damian Lillard led Portland with 25; Ayo Dosunmu scored 30 for Minnesota
Deni Avdija sat with a sore left foot, his first missed game of the season
Clingan had 12 points and 12 boards, but his late pass was picked off
Next up: Thursday at Milwaukee, with Avdija's status unclear

timbers.pulse: No game since the regular season ended, so the vibe is all playoff build-up. The Timbers come in as the West's No. 7 seed on a four-game win streak, and Velde says the group is embracing the underdog role against No. 2 FC Dallas.
storylines: Game 1 at FC Dallas: Sat Nov 21, 1 p.m. Pacific, on Apple TV
Game 2 at Providence Park: Sat Nov 28
Season series: a 2-2 draw in Portland and a 2-1 Dallas win in Frisco
Cifuentes says Antony has a chance to return from a month-long knee issue (Rotowire, Nov 16)
Rolled in on four straight wins to clinch the No. 7 seed

f1.pulse: It's race week in Las Vegas. Both titles already belong to Antonelli and Mercedes, so the buzz is the scrap for second place, where Verstappen is the in-form driver after three wins in his last five races.
storylines: Las Vegas GP this weekend; three races left
P2 fight: Verstappen 279, Russell 262, Hamilton 261, Leclerc 249, Norris 246
Verstappen has podiums in eight straight and is chasing a third Vegas win
Cadillac seat question: stick with Bottas or give Colton Herta his F1 shot

ducks.pulse: Duck fans are still riding high after the 31-7 rout of Michigan, and the Ducks are now big road favorites at struggling Michigan State. The only thing nagging anyone is that the Spartans have never lost to Oregon in East Lansing.
storylines: Next game: Friday Nov 20 at Michigan State, 5:00 p.m. Pacific on FOX
Oregon (7-3, No. 16) is about a 16-point favorite
Oregon is 0-3 all-time in East Lansing, but Michigan State is 3-7 and QB Alessio Milivojevic is hurt
Coming off a 31-7 win over Michigan; regular-season finale vs. Washington Nov 28

niners.pulse: Fans are still buzzing from the 46-40 shootout in Dallas that put the 49ers at 8-1, but the leaky pass rush has Niners Nation uneasy. Sunday's game in Mexico City is framed as a real test for Purdy against Brian Flores' defense, with thin air on top.
storylines: Next game: Sunday Nov 22 vs. Vikings in Mexico City, 5:20 p.m. Pacific on NBC/Peacock
Team prepping for altitude in Colorado Springs before flying in
Pass rush worry: zero sacks in Dallas and Bosa still hunting his first sack since returning
Vikings WR Jordan Addison headed for short-term IR after thumb surgery (Star Tribune)

sources.name: NBC Sports Bay Area (how to watch)
